name: GravityFloat
_intent: Gravity flipped: the hero floats weightless 2.2 studs above standing height (feet ~2.2 clear of the floor), upright but relaxed: arms drifting out and up, hands open, knees soft with the right leg higher, head back, a slow bob of +-0.2 and a gentle roll of the torso.
